message:
Migrate auth to auth.romaine.life (drop MSAL + shared HS256 JWT)

Backend now verifies JWTs against auth.romaine.life's JWKS endpoint
(RS256, signed by Better Auth's JWT plugin) instead of self-signing
with the shared `api-jwt-signing-secret`. Auth-related Cosmos upserts
go away — identity lives entirely in the auth service's Postgres.

Deleted:
- backend/microsoft-routes.js — entire Microsoft-token-exchange + JWT
  issuance is now auth.romaine.life's job
- frontend/src/auth/msal.js — no more MSAL on the frontend; sign-in is
  a plain redirect to the auth service

Changed:
- backend/auth.js — `jsonwebtoken`/`jwks-rsa` swapped for `jose`
  (`createRemoteJWKSet` + `jwtVerify`). `createRequireAuth` no longer
  takes a `jwtSecret` arg
- backend/config.js — drops the Key Vault fetch of
  `api-jwt-signing-secret` and the enumeration of Microsoft client IDs.
  Now only reads `cosmos_db_endpoint` from App Configuration
- backend/server.js — drops the Microsoft routes mount; passes nothing
  to `createRequireAuth()`
- backend/package.json — `jsonwebtoken`, `jwks-rsa`,
  `@azure/keyvault-secrets` out; `jose` in
- frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.jsx — rewritten:
  - On mount, fetches a JWT from auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token
    (the session cookie on `.romaine.life` is auto-attached)
  - Schedules a silent refresh 60 s before `exp`
  - `signIn()` redirects to auth.romaine.life/api/auth/sign-in/social/microsoft
  - `signOut()` clears the cookie via auth.romaine.life/api/auth/sign-out
  - Same exported shape as before (`useAuth()` returns
    `{user, token, loading, isAdmin, signIn, signOut, logout}`) so
    callers don't need updates
- frontend/src/api/client.js + frontend/src/components/UserProfile.jsx
  — replace `loginWithMicrosoft` imports with the redirect / `signIn`
  hook
- frontend/package.json — `@azure/msal-browser` out
- Dockerfile + .github/workflows/build-and-deploy.yaml — drop the
  `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID` build arg and the App Configuration fetch
  that fed it
- k8s/deployment.yaml — drop `KEY_VAULT_URL` env (no Key Vault reads
  from the pod anymore)

User data note: existing Cosmos records keyed by `microsoft|<MS-sub>`
will no longer match (auth.romaine.life's JWT carries a Better-Auth
random user.id). For a single-user system this is a clean reset
rather than a migration concern. If history matters later, can map
by email at the boundary on first call.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

issue.body:
## Context

Auth consolidation landed for tank-operator (gates on the JWT \`role\` claim from this service, no per-app email allowlist). The remaining \`.romaine.life\` apps still run their own MSAL flow + \`ALLOWED_EMAILS\` env var; this ticket tracks moving each onto the same delegation pattern.

Source of truth: [tank-operator#472](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/472) is the canonical migration template. Read it first.

## Pre-flight (already done)

- auth.romaine.life issues a JWT with \`{ sub, email, name, role, apps }\`. Default role for any fresh Microsoft sign-up is \`pending\`; an admin must promote to \`user\` (or \`admin\`) via [/admin](https://auth.romaine.life/admin).
- \`https://tank.romaine.life\` listed in \`trustedOrigins\` ([src/auth.ts](src/auth.ts)) and the CORS allow-list ([src/server.ts](src/server.ts)). **Add each migrating app's hostname to both** before merging that app's PR or its silent-exchange fetch will CORS-fail.
- GET handler at \`/sign-in/microsoft?callbackURL=...\` is the entry point downstream apps redirect to.
- 5 admin emails pre-seeded in Better Auth's \`user\` table (nelson@romaine.life as \`admin\`; the 4 friend emails as \`user\`).

## Migration pattern (per app)

For each repo:

1. **Backend gate change**: replace the email allowlist with role-claim verification. Delete \`ALLOWED_EMAILS\` env / ExternalSecret entry. \`NewVerifier\` accepts role ∈ {admin, user} and 403s everything else (including \`pending\`). The session JWT this app mints needs to carry the role through, same as [tank-operator's MintSession](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/backend-go/internal/auth/mint.go).
2. **Frontend bootstrap**: copy [tank-operator's frontend/src/auth.ts](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/frontend/src/auth.ts) shape — \`bootstrapAuth\` (existing token → silent-exchange via cookie → render Sign-in button), \`startLogin\` ($auth_url/sign-in/microsoft?callbackURL=$origin), \`logout\` (clear local + remote session).
3. **Exchange endpoint**: \`POST /api/auth/exchange\` with body \`{ \"auth_jwt\": \"<jwt>\" }\`. Verify against \`auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks\`, pin issuer, accept role ∈ {admin, user}, mint your own session JWT.
4. **Delete the old MSAL surface end-to-end** per [tank-operator's docs/migration-policy.md](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/docs/migration-policy.md): no \`/api/auth/microsoft/login\` route, no \`credential\` body field, no \`ENTRA_CLIENT_ID\` env / KV mount, no Entra app reg in the app's own tofu.
5. **Add this app's origin** to \`CROSS_APP_ORIGINS\` ([src/server.ts](src/server.ts)) and \`trustedOrigins\` ([src/auth.ts](src/auth.ts)). One small PR here, merged before the app's migration PR.
6. **Drop the per-app admin-emails CSV** if the app has one (e.g. glimmung's \`tofu/admin-emails.tf\`); the role claim replaces it.

## Apps in scope

- [ ] **kill-me** — has [an open PR #32](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/32) that started this migration. Rebase onto current main and resolve.
- [ ] **plant-agent** — not started. Has its own MSAL flow.
- [ ] **investing** — not started.
- [ ] **house-hunt** — not started.
- [ ] **fzt-frontend** — not started.
- [ ] **glimmung** — most involved. Still on MSAL with its own \`glimmung-oauth\` Entra app reg ([tofu/oauth.tf](https://github.com/nelsong6/glimmung/blob/main/tofu/oauth.tf)) and a local admin emails list ([tofu/admin-emails.tf](https://github.com/nelsong6/glimmung/blob/main/tofu/admin-emails.tf), added in #497 to decouple from the retired \`romaine-life-admin-emails\` KV secret). Both the Entra app reg and the local list go away on migration. Also see the glimmung slot-redirect cleanup note below.

## Glimmung-specific note: slot-redirect URI maintenance

Before [tank-operator#471](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/471), glimmung was updating the redirect URI list on tank-operator's \`tank-operator-oauth-test\` Entra app reg whenever it reconciled validation slots (the \`lifecycle.ignore_changes\` block in the now-deleted \`oauth_app.tf\` was the contract). That app reg's been deleted; glimmung's update-redirect-URI logic will fail against a missing target.

In the new architecture, slot URLs don't need slot-specific redirect URI registration at the Entra level — slots just pass their own URL as \`callbackURL\` when redirecting to \`auth.romaine.life/sign-in/microsoft\`. The fix is to **delete that whole code path** in glimmung. Cleanest to bundle it with glimmung's own auth migration above.

## Acceptance criteria

- No app reads \`ALLOWED_EMAILS\` from KV. The role claim is the only gate.
- No app has its own Entra/Microsoft app registration — \`auth-romaine-life-microsoft-oauth\` is the only one in tofu/Azure.
- Adding a new \`.romaine.life\` user is a single action: admin enrolls via [/admin](https://auth.romaine.life/admin).
- Demoting a user revokes app access on the next exchange (existing session JWTs expire on their own).
- All 6 apps + auth.romaine.life sign-in flow tested end-to-end.

## Related PRs

- [nelsong6/auth#13](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/pull/13) — role claim + /admin console + default=pending
- [nelsong6/auth#14](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/pull/14) — GET /sign-in/microsoft entry point
- [nelsong6/auth#15](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/pull/15) — CORS middleware for cross-app fetches
- [nelsong6/tank-operator#472](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/472) — full migration template
- [nelsong6/tank-operator#473](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/473) — mcp-auth UAMI wiring (related)
- [nelsong6/tank-operator#474](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/474) — startLogin URL fix
- [nelsong6/infra-bootstrap#114](https://github.com/nelsong6/infra-bootstrap/pull/114) — delete shared admin-emails KV secret, wire mcp-auth app
- [nelsong6/glimmung#497](https://github.com/nelsong6/glimmung/pull/497) — temporary glimmung-local admin-emails (replace on migration)

issue.title: Migrate remaining .romaine.life apps onto auth.romaine.life delegation

issue.body:
## Summary

Replaces kill-me's bespoke Microsoft sign-in with delegated auth to [auth.romaine.life](https://auth.romaine.life). Microsoft sign-in happens upstream; this app verifies the upstream RS256 JWT against auth.romaine.life's JWKS, gates on the role claim (`admin`/`user` only — `pending` gets 403), and mints its own HS256 session JWT for downstream API calls. Mirrors the canonical template from [tank-operator#472](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/472).

Closes the kill-me side of [nelsong6/auth#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/issues/16). **Supersedes [#32](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/32)** which predated the canonical template (fetched `/api/auth/token` client-side, POSTed to `/api/auth/sign-in/social/microsoft` — both wrong).

## Pattern

- **Frontend** ([frontend/src/auth/index.js](frontend/src/auth/index.js)): `bootstrapAuth → startLogin → logout`. Silent exchange on boot via `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token` cookie (the `.romaine.life` session cookie is auto-attached cross-origin). `startLogin` redirects to `${auth_url}/sign-in/microsoft?callbackURL=...` (GET wrapper, not the POST-only Better Auth route — per tank-operator [#474](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/474)).
- **Backend** ([backend/auth-routes.js](backend/auth-routes.js) + [backend/auth.js](backend/auth.js)): `POST /api/auth/exchange` with `{auth_jwt}` body. `exchangeRomaineLifeToken` verifies RS256 against `https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks` (jose's `createRemoteJWKSet` handles caching), pins issuer = `https://auth.romaine.life`, accepts `role ∈ {admin, user}` only.
- **Local session JWT**: HS256, signed with `kill-me-jwt-signing-secret` (already provisioned in [tofu/keyvault.tf](tofu/keyvault.tf), just newly wired in `config.js`). Carries the upstream role claim through.

## End-to-end deletions (per [tank-operator/docs/migration-policy.md](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/docs/migration-policy.md))

| Deleted | Why |
|---|---|
| `backend/microsoft-routes.js` | Replaced by `auth-routes.js` |
| `frontend/src/auth/msal.js` | MSAL gone from frontend |
| `@azure/msal-browser` dep | No MSAL imports anywhere |
| `jwks-rsa` dep | Only used for Microsoft JWKS; `jose` replaces it |
| `ALLOWED_EMAIL` constant + hardcoded `nelson-devops-project@outlook.com` | Role claim is the only gate now |
| `config.js` listConfigurationSettings enumeration | No per-app Microsoft client IDs to discover |
| `config.js` read of `api-jwt-signing-secret` | Per-app secret instead |
| Dockerfile + docker-build-check + build-and-deploy `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID` | Not in the bundle anymore |
| `tofu/oauth.tf` | The per-app Entra app registration |
| `tofu/appconfig.tf` | Only published `microsoft_oauth_client_id` |
| `tofu/identity.tf` KV scope | Flipped to `kill-me-jwt-signing-secret` |
| CLAUDE.md auth model + data flow + .env docs | Rewritten to describe new flow |

## Guard

[scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs](scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs) greps every committed file for retired patterns (`@azure/msal-browser`, `/auth/microsoft/login`, `ALLOWED_EMAILS`, `api-jwt-signing-secret`, `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`, `microsoft_oauth_client_id`, `jwks-rsa`, etc.) and exits non-zero. Wired as a CI job in `.github/workflows/lint.yaml` so reintroduction breaks at PR time.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run build` succeeds without `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`
- [x] `node scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs` returns clean
- [ ] **Phase 0 (auth#18 + auth#19) deployed**: `curl -i -X OPTIONS -H "Origin: https://workout.romaine.life" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: GET" https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token` returns ACA header for `workout.romaine.life` (already had it pre-#19)
- [ ] After this image rolls: anonymous visit to `workout.romaine.life` shows snapshot view + Sign-in button
- [ ] Click Sign in → redirects to `auth.romaine.life` → Microsoft completes → returns to `workout.romaine.life` signed in
- [ ] Already signed into another `.romaine.life` app → reload of `workout.romaine.life` silently signs in (no redirect)
- [ ] Admin can log workouts (write path through JWT bearer)
- [ ] Sign Out → cookies cleared on both auth.romaine.life and workout.romaine.life → back to anonymous
- [ ] Demote yourself to `user` in auth.romaine.life/admin → next bootstrap returns 403; demote to `pending` → also 403

## Sequencing notes

- Per migration plan: tofu cleanup of the per-app Entra app reg (already in this PR — `tofu/oauth.tf` deletion) lands with the code PR rather than as a separate follow-up. The infra-bootstrap PR that drops the SPA redirect URIs from the shared `microsoft_login` app reg comes last, after all 6 apps migrate.
- Cosmos records keyed by `microsoft|<MS-sub>` (the old account ID format) won't match the new JWT `sub` (Better Auth's random user.id). For a single-user-class system this is a fresh start; old records sit unreferenced until cleaned up.

issue.title: Migrate auth to auth.romaine.life delegation (drop MSAL + per-app allowlist)

body: Superseded by #34, which rewrites the migration to match the canonical template (tank-operator#472): silent exchange via POST /api/auth/exchange with {auth_jwt} body, GET /sign-in/microsoft entry point, role-claim gating instead of email allowlist, end-to-end deletion per migration-policy.md. This PR's older approach (fetching /api/auth/token client-side + POST /api/auth/sign-in/social/microsoft) doesn't match what auth.romaine.life now expects.
